messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled config-only deploy: cfg-2026-03-23-microguard (initiated by devon). Change window: 2026-03-23 12:15-12:45 UTC. Targets: routing-policy, batching, limits. Staged rollout suggested. Please review and ack.
devon: quick summary — not touching model binaries. Changes:
- routing: add `region_prefer: eu-west` for tenant_cohort B
- batching: `max_batch_tokens: 3072` (was 4096) and `max_batch_size: 32`
- timeouts: `request_timeout_ms: 10000` (was 12000)
- limits: tenant softcap 75rps -> 60rps
Canary plan: 5% x 20m -> 25% x 20m -> 100% if green. Deploybot command at bottom.
maria: flagged: reducing max_batch_tokens might increase p99 for long-context requests. Do we have recent p95/p99 by seq_len? Link: https://console.redwood/obs/rollouts/1234
sanjay: Agree with Maria. Also we saw KV cache churn spike last week for tenant_cohort B — lowering batch tokens could make it worse. Recommend we keep `kv_cache_ttl_ms: 120000` (increase from 60k) for canary only.
devon: good catch. Update: canary will set `kv_cache_ttl_ms: 120000` for first two waves, revert to default at 100% if stable.
ops-jen: Ops checklist:
- preflight smoke at 5% that checks: 1) 99th latency within +10% of baseline 2) error rate < 0.1% 3) kv cache eviction rate not rising >2x
- deploybot dry-run and health probes enabled
- rollback triggers: auto-rollback if p99 > baseline * 1.15 for 5m OR error rate spike >0.2% over 3m
Please add observability alerts for these.
maria: add one more: watch tail of rerank requests — their token counts are high and may push p99. Maybe exclude rerank namespace from batching change for canary.
devon: ok exclude `rerank/*` from `max_batch_tokens` reduction during canary. Will patch config.
ops-jen: confirm release notes snippet for customers: "Config-only performance tuning to reduce cost and stabilize throughput; routing preference to improve EU locality. No model changes." Need to publish 12:00 UTC.
sanjay: small nit — ensure model pin: keep model pinned to `rdw-3b-v2` for this rollout, so fallback model swaps don't confound metrics.
devon: pinned to rdw-3b-v2 for canary + GA. Added to deploy command.
deploy-bot: To start rollout run: `/deploy cfg-2026-03-23-microguard --staged 5:20m,25:20m,100:— --health-checks p99,errors,kv_eviction --pin-model rdw-3b-v2 --meta "canary-exclude: rerank/*"`
maria: ack from perf side. Will watch dashboards.
sanjay: ops ack — will monitor kv cache graphs and be ready to flip revert.
ops-jen: security/compliance: no secrets change, nothing to review. thumbs up.
devon: launching at 12:15 UTC. If anyone sees anything odd ping @ops on-call and run `/deploy rollback cfg-2026-03-23-microguard`.
maria: :thumbsup:
sanjay: :rocket:
